cases.expected: The List returned by getTupleSchema() reflects the element added to the original List after the PrefixItemsValidator was constructed (size increased).
cases.description: Create a mutable List, construct PrefixItemsValidator with it, then add a new JsonSchema to the original List. Verify that getTupleSchema() returns a List that now includes the newly added element, demonstrating that the validator holds a live reference to the supplied list.

cases.expected: Two successive calls to getTupleSchema() return the exact same List instance (reference equality).
cases.description: Invoke getTupleSchema() twice on the same PrefixItemsValidator instance and assert that the returned objects are `==` (the same reference), confirming that the method does not create a new List on each call.

cases.expected: Calling add() on the List returned by getTupleSchema() throws UnsupportedOperationException.
cases.description: Construct PrefixItemsValidator with `Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>())`. Retrieve the tuple schema via getTupleSchema() and attempt to modify it. The operation should fail with an UnsupportedOperationException, showing that the validator does not wrap or copy the list.

cases.expected: A List of size 1 containing a null entry is returned by getTupleSchema().
cases.description: Pass a List that contains a single `null` element to the PrefixItemsValidator constructor. Verify that getTupleSchema() returns a non‑null List whose sole element is `null`, confirming that the validator does not filter out null entries.
